Action Gate mediates every Execution Capability
Assurance extension uses a versioned Registry
User action authorization adapts Harness ApprovalService
Mission Contract is the specification authority
Repository standards use a captured Baseline
Action Decisions are durable before execution
Plan and Assurance freeze after independent review
Role Agents use a pre-publication Governed Provider
Web surfaces are additive Session projections

nodes.rationale: Browser smoke tests against packed installation ensure client compatibility beyond TypeScript compilation

nodes.label: Migration Proof
nodes.rationale: Byte-level fixtures verify transactional migration, rollback on fault, and Safe Mode for corrupt stores

nodes.label: Packed Installation
nodes.rationale: npm pack and tarball installation ensure plugin operates within declared peer dependencies and public exports

nodes.label: Release Promotion
nodes.rationale: RC-to-stable requires passing all gates and manual dogfood mission to ensure production readiness

nodes.label: Security Assurance External Provider
nodes.rationale: Security Assurance integrates through Provider boundary to maintain separation of concerns

nodes.label: External Assurance By Value
nodes.rationale: Immutable digest-bound submissions prevent provider loss or mutation from altering Mission decisions

nodes.label: Host Policy Activation
nodes.rationale: Host Policy controls provider selection to prevent unauthorized provider self-registration

nodes.label: Machine Providers as Assessors
nodes.rationale: Machine Provider distinction prevents scanners from impersonating independent Reviewer roles

nodes.label: Kernel-Issued Execution Context
nodes.rationale: Mediated execution context prevents external providers from accessing Store, Gate, or unrestricted host capabilities

nodes.label: Provider Fail-Closed
nodes.rationale: Missing providers trigger Safe Mode to prevent silent degradation of assurance requirements

nodes.label: Sealed External Assessments
nodes.rationale: Only sealed assessments are importable to ensure evidence integrity

nodes.label: Security Risk Acceptance Authority
nodes.rationale: Decision Authority binding ensures risk acceptance cannot bypass governance controls

nodes.label: Security Remediation Through Rework
nodes.rationale: Security Assurance cannot apply changes directly to enforce separation of assessment and implementation

nodes.label: Findings Close on New Evidence
nodes.rationale: New sealed assessment required to close findings ensures patch verification is properly validated

nodes.label: Security Integration Proof
nodes.rationale: Unsafe Approval Rate measurement ensures integrated Quality Gate is useful and safe, not just functional

nodes.label: Submission Transport Integrity
nodes.rationale: Transport integrity separate from gate eligibility ensures digest verification doesn't imply assessment validity

nodes.label: Post-Implementation Subject
nodes.rationale: Provider execution after implementation ensures assessment runs against code that will reach Quality Gate

nodes.label: Mission Cancellation Quiescence
nodes.rationale: Explicit cancellation with quiescence proof prevents leaving unproven external work behind cancelled missions

nodes.label: Provider Cancellation Retry
nodes.rationale: Idempotent cancellation retry reconciles external state after host restart interrupts cancellation transaction

nodes.label: External Assessment Failure
nodes.rationale: External failure produces indeterminate assessment to distinguish from security findings and safety approval

nodes.label: Assurance Retry
nodes.rationale: Successor invocation with linked history enables retry without replaying settled identities

nodes.label: Repository Binding
nodes.rationale: Process-local repository equality prevents path leakage while enabling same-repository validation

nodes.label: Codex Ecosystem Reuse Study
nodes.rationale: Study identifies verified mechanisms for runtime ownership, cancellation, approval, and lifecycle from Codex ecosystem

nodes.label: DeepSeek Harness Source Study
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive study maps Engineering Control Plane requirements to DeepSeek Harness extension points and establishes architecture boundaries
